description: Every live ladder of a wallet (on the current LoomLadder and earlier ones): pair, rungs with what each holds and which side of the price it is on, value, fees waiting (after LoomDesk's share), fees already collected, PnL against simply holding what went in, and the wallet's history of opens, collects, partial withdraws and closes. A ladder that is a limit order (opened with one asset, never re-laid) carries `limitOrder`: its side, what it holds at this moment and how much of it stands filled (a part fill is undone when the price turns back), the most it has been filled, and whether it is closed once filled.
name: my_ladders
title: A wallet's ladders and what it has done
